courses.title: Video Editing & Post-Production
courses.subtitle: Go from raw footage to client-ready films, ads and YouTube videos with a professional workflow.
courses.description: A complete, self-paced path through professional post-production. You will learn to organise footage, build a story in the edit, clean up sound, grade colour and deliver correctly for every platform. Each module ends with a practical project, so you finish with a portfolio you can show to clients and employers.
outcomes: Edit complete videos from raw footage to final export
Use pacing, cuts and B-roll to tell a clear story
Clean up dialogue and mix music and sound effects
Colour correct and grade footage in DaVinci Resolve
Add animated titles and lower thirds in After Effects
Build a three-project portfolio for clients
requirements: A computer with at least 8 GB RAM
Adobe Premiere Pro (the free trial is fine to start) and DaVinci Resolve (free)

courses.title: Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy
courses.subtitle: Plan, launch and measure campaigns in live classes with a working growth strategist.
courses.description: A live, cohort-based programme for people who want to grow a real business or start a marketing career. Across eight weeks you will research an audience, build a content and SEO plan, run paid campaigns and report on results. Every class is interactive, and your work gets direct feedback from the instructor.
outcomes: Research an audience and define a clear positioning
Build a content calendar and SEO plan
Launch and optimise Meta and Google ad campaigns
Track results with Google Analytics
Calculate customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend
Present a complete growth strategy for a real brand
requirements: A computer and a stable internet connection for live classes
A Facebook account for ad exercises

courses.title: Sports Journalism & Sports Media
courses.subtitle: Learn reporting, interviewing and digital sports publishing with recorded lessons and live newsroom sessions.
courses.description: Learn the craft from a working sports journalist. Recorded lessons teach news writing, match reports, interviews and video scripting at your own pace. Live newsroom sessions then put those skills to work, with real-time match coverage and honest editorial feedback on your stories.
outcomes: Write accurate, engaging sports news and match reports
Prepare for and conduct professional interviews
Cover live matches for web and social media
Script and present short video reports
Apply media ethics and fact-checking
Build a published portfolio of sports stories
requirements: An interest in cricket, football or other sports

courses.title: Software Development & Programming
courses.subtitle: Build and deploy complete web applications, with recorded lessons and live code reviews.
courses.description: A practical route from your first line of code to a deployed full-stack application. Recorded lessons cover programming fundamentals, TypeScript, Angular, ASP.NET Core and SQL Server. Weekly live sessions add code reviews and problem solving, so you learn to work the way professional software teams do.
outcomes: Understand programming fundamentals and problem solving
Build responsive pages with HTML, CSS and Bootstrap
Create single-page applications with Angular and TypeScript
Build REST APIs with ASP.NET Core
Design and query a SQL Server database
Use Git and deploy a full-stack project
requirements: A computer with at least 8 GB RAM and internet access
Basic computer skills — no coding experience needed
